Projects / Planning Stage

Health Map — Healthcare & Wellness Discovery Platform

Planned geospatial discovery platform to help users find healthcare and wellness services across Bengaluru, including hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, fitness facilities, and wellness providers.

Planning / Architecture

Project Status: Planning & Architecture Stage

This project is currently in the planning and system design phase. The architecture, features, and technical approach described below represent proposed solutions based on requirements analysis and research, not deployed implementation.

Problem & Solution

Problem

Finding appropriate healthcare and wellness services in a large city like Bengaluru is challenging. Users need to discover nearby providers, understand services offered, filter by specialization, and make informed decisions. Providers need a platform for listing verification and accurate information management.

Proposed Solution

A geospatial discovery platform using React.js frontend, FastAPI backend, and PostgreSQL with PostGIS for efficient location-based queries. Focus on accurate provider information, privacy-conscious data handling, and user-friendly discovery workflows.

Proposed Architecture

Health Map architecture emphasizes geospatial performance, data accuracy, and privacy. PostgreSQL with PostGIS extension provides robust geospatial capabilities. FastAPI enables rapid API development with automatic documentation. React.js frontend consumes geospatial APIs for interactive discovery.

Engineering Decisions & Tradeoffs

PostgreSQL with PostGIS over MongoDB geospatial

Rationale: PostGIS offers more sophisticated geospatial operations, better performance for complex queries, industry-standard coordinate system support, and stronger data integrity for healthcare information.

Considerations: PostGIS is more complex to learn but provides significantly better geospatial capabilities. For healthcare discovery, accuracy and performance are critical.

FastAPI for backend

Rationale: Modern Python framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation, type validation with Pydantic, async support for performance, and excellent PostgreSQL integration.

Considerations: FastAPI is newer than Flask/Django but has strong community, excellent documentation, and is well-suited for API-first development.

React.js for frontend

Rationale: Component-based architecture for map interactions, rich ecosystem of map libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox), TypeScript support for type safety, good mobile performance.

Considerations: Considered Next.js but discovery platform doesn't require SSR. React provides flexibility for interactive map features.

Separate frontend and backend

Rationale: FastAPI backend provides clean API layer; React frontend can be deployed independently; clear separation of concerns; easier to scale services separately.

Considerations: More deployment complexity than monolith but better scalability and maintenance.
